item.title: Junction of Cedar Road With Maple Road Brockworth area of broken up pavement area, 13th August
item.description:
The area of pavement on this corner of Maple Drive and Cedar Road is in poor condition 1: There is extensive area of grass growing through broken tarmac surfacing (this is primarily a Highway authority issue). It is probable that this whole area needs resurfacing. 2. There is also a street tree that needs attention to manage it effectively (primarily a Highway authority issue). 3. There is a significant accumulation of detritus around the tree which needs clearing (primarily a Tewkesbury BC issue) A report will also be sent to Tewkesbury BC

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 32, Cedar Road, Coopers Edge, Gloucester
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Prince Albert Court - overgrown verge opposite houses h, 13th August
item.description:
Prince Albert Court is an unkempt fcul de sac which needs focused attention by both highways and TBC. 1: There is an unkept hammer head with long grass adjacent to no2 rear of 32 Ermin Park (probably highway responsibility) 2: There is signs of detritus and weeds along kerb in various point (primarily a district council responsibility) 3. A completely uncared for highway verge (opposite houses above about 30- end of road). This has grown into the road by about a metre. There is also excessive detritus in this area (This is a probably a shared highway and borough council responsibility). This report will also be sent to TBC

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Prince Albert Court, Coopers Edge, Tewkesbury
